name: Newton Fractal
desc: A Newton-method root-basin fractal for z^n minus one whose roots slowly orbit and whose over-relaxation coefficient swirls, so saturated stained-glass basins churn along their infinitely-filigreed boundaries — also rendered as polished metallic chrome, a cyan blueprint of boundary lines, iron thermal false-color, or hatched monochrome ink.

scale.doc: view zoom into the basin field (higher = deeper boundary detail)

swirl.doc: over-relaxation orbit — how hard the basin boundaries warp/swirl

roots.doc: number of root basins (n in z^n-1)

hue.doc: palette base hue (basins spread around from here)
